title: antigravity-session-history skill: SKILL.md, references (sources, recipes, brief template), evals; no scripts (D112), per R20 section 8
owner: parent (interactive /skill-creator run in the lane worktree)
base_rule: base_sha = the integration commit the allocation commit is built on; the worktree is cut from the allocation commit
required_checks: gitleaks dir --config .gitleaks.toml on the skill tree (no TR names)

resource_admissions.antigravity_data: read-only copies into the session scratchpad for eval runs; never open live files, never run the app or agy

notes: no scripts/ directory: the parser boundary is a C++ ticket (R20 section 8 item 8)
eval prompts must not name TR; use a generic workspace substring
